note: The seven header lines of a brief (spec t-1765 section 3.4), rendered by brief_pack.sd_head_lines for a role whose agent file is a charter (scripts/charter.py is_charter). goal and DoD come from the charter, given from the brief's own file list, owns from references/artifact-writers.json, handoff from handoff.contract_of; non_goals and questions are per role here. A line with no data prints the em dash and the reason, never dropped (AR-23).

empty.goal: the charter has no Outcome section
empty.DoD: the charter has no numbered item under Good outcome
empty.given: the stage declares no input file
empty.owns: the registry names no artifact of this role at this stage
empty.non-goals: the brief form names none for this role
empty.handoff: no handoff contract is registered for this stage and role
empty.questions: the brief form names no road for this role

qa-scout.non_goals: no plan, no cases, no stand probing beyond liveness; never edit application or test code; no external writes
qa-scout.questions: open fact: unresolved_facts of work/context-manifest.json; go on with the recommendation; halt only with no diff and nobody to ask

qa-requirements-tester.non_goals: no plan, no cases; never resolve a contradiction yourself; no requirement without a source; no external writes
qa-requirements-tester.questions: open_questions[] of work/requirements-readiness.json; continue on the recommendation, mark it until answered; halt only when the bundle is missing or empty

qa-test-strategist.non_goals: no test files, no case text; never pick a reading of a contradiction; never cut scope silently
qa-test-strategist.questions: new_questions of the plan row that rests on it, a branch per answer; continue on the recommendation, mark it until answered; halt only when the register is missing or empty

qa-case-designer.non_goals: no stand probing, no test code; never re-assign priority, class or basis of the plan row
qa-case-designer.questions: a Then no source gives is unknown with its question, or raise with a raise_questions entry that the driver turns into a register question; a case that cannot be written at all is stuck, never the stage

qa-runner.non_goals: no diagnosis, no change of case or bug status; a handed_to_person case is the person's; never write results[] by hand
qa-runner.questions: requirements silent: an unresolved_question at once, go on; access a person can give is a question; a probed gap is a recorded gap

qa-failure-analyst.non_goals: never change an expectation to match the product; no repair but a test defect, a flaky test, a reorder; no bug record before gate B
qa-failure-analyst.questions: settle it yourself first (faq.md, the evidence, a control experiment); two readings both tenable: one question with both quotes, go on

qa-bug-reporter.non_goals: no draft the person did not choose; never argue the triage verdict, change a case status or fix a test; never write to a tracker; no application code
qa-bug-reporter.questions: a question for the person goes in questions[] of your form, you do not stop for it; halt only when no gate B decision is recorded

qa-doc-scribe.non_goals: no second report file; no number, verdict, bug or size typed by hand; never add a roll-call row or reconcile ledger.json and the report by hand
qa-doc-scribe.questions: what the person must decide is an item of Left with you, in words; halt only when a script fails or the roll-call names a missing requirement or case

qa-retro-analyst.non_goals: no recomputed number; never move or archive the artifact folder or set archived; no edit of a strategy document that is not editable
qa-retro-analyst.questions: the person's one closing question is the orchestrator's: you record the answer verbatim; halt only when work/retro-numbers.json is missing

qa-automator.non_goals: no application code; no literal for an expectation left open; no workaround or silent drop of a step the product does not allow; no suite-wide run
qa-automator.questions: a step the product does not allow, or an absent field: `unresolved` with a question, go on; a doubt about a case travels with its red test to S7

qa-code-critic.non_goals: never fix the tests or weaken an assertion; no product code edit in the main tree; do not re-report what code already checked
qa-code-critic.questions: a doubt about the case goes to S7 with the red test; a proof the stand stopped is `unverified` with why; stop after the review cap
